author: cinammoncroc000
body:
So, as any Avicus player, I felt like playing Avicus.
I got on the server and while I was admiring the new layout in the Game Selection, someone said:
"Hey, where's skywars?"

Immediately I found out two things about this person:
1.) He hasn't been active for a while
2.) He doesn't know that Skywars is gone

To inform him, I say:
"Sorry, Skywars has been removed. Sorry :("

And then the guy says:
"OK IM OUT"
and immediately 5 people leave the lobby at relatively the same time.

Yeah that was interesting...
I just want to know why Skywars was removed. Skywars was one of the most enticing and interesting minigames on this server; seeing it go was a big disappointment, despite Nexus and later Nebula being introduced. Skywars was the first minigame I played on here; if it weren't for it, I wouldn't have joined and met the amazing community. I'm not saying that we should bring it back, I just want an answer on why it was removed...

Also, I know for a fact that there were probably numerous topics written just for the same reason, so...

replies.body: It was. Now, the typical Skywars minigame is basically Skyblock put into hunger games. This was more of a Walls-like minigame in the sky but it was so much more in-depth than that. replies.author: hpux
replies.body: I guess no one played it since a ton of servers had Skywars, and a lot of them were better than ours. Right now I don't think we should focus more on getting players to play our 2 "inactive" games" Elimination and Avicade. CTH is gaining players, so it's starting to be alive now. Avicade used to have a lot of players when Avicore first came out, but now no one plays it. Elimination used to have between 15-30 players each match but towards the last month before Avicore came out it started to die. Now we're lucky if even 1 match starts per day.
